input_ref: explore member | Member: How much will my prescription cost?

output.reason: None of the approved units states what the member's prescription will cost. U-BEN-COST-001-02 is a disclaimer for in-network medical visit estimates, not prescriptions. U-BEN-COST-001-05 covers specialist referrals. U-RX-EDU-001-05 covers when a caregiver can be told a drug price and gives no price.
